question: Should the new exported shared ingress-monitor API be accepted as the durable plugin-SDK contract for the six migrated channel adapters?
rationale: The branch changes generated plugin-SDK surface hashes and centralizes delivery lifecycle behavior; choosing the permanent public seam and acceptable compatibility commitment requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the shared SDK seam
options.body: Confirm that `createChannelIngressMonitor` is the intended additive plugin-SDK contract, then request a rebased review plus focused real channel lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep the helper internal
options.body: Move the shared monitor behind a bundled-runtime boundary if maintainers do not want to expand the external plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Defer the migration until owners define the supported extension contract and compatibility plan for durable ingress.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared SDK seam
recommendation.body: Confirm that `createChannelIngressMonitor` is the intended additive plugin-SDK contract, then request a rebased review plus focused real channel lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit series shows direct ownership of the proposed shared monitor migration across all affected channel adapters.
